title: What Does a Skill Actually Do? Estimands and Evaluation Validity for Tool and Skill Use in LLM Agents: A Critical Review
title_zh: 十三个核心实证研究和相关方法论工作综合证据：工具和技能设计分析

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly draw on external tools and reusable skills selected at run time from libraries that hold thousands of entries. Reports that a retriever, router, or skill library “improves” an agent may refer to retrieval recall, the success change from enabling a library, a paired contrast restricted to triggered tasks, or a gain under an approximate budget constraint. This critical review asks what each design compares and under which assumptions. Building on estimand-based approaches to agent evaluation, we describe tool and skill designs along six axes: treatment contrast, target population, outcome, budget constraint, summary measure, and identification assumptions. Thirteen core empirical studies anchor the evidence synthesis, supplemented by related methodological work and design-level reading of the wider literature. Our contribution is to make explicit distinctions that some source authors already acknowledge, through a decomposition of trigger-conditioned pairing, analytic counterexamples, and comparisons across studies. Pairing on the task does not by itself identify an invocation effect; paired gain and regression counts measure protocol-specific discordance rather than the share of tasks whose expected outcomes worsen; and total effects of module deployment answer a different question from budget-constrained efficiency. We compare curated skill provision with retriever replacement, triggered subsets with all-task outcomes, and observed cost reductions with budget-constrained comparisons. A reporting checklist and worked examples connect these distinctions to information that studies can report. The review runs no new experiments; empirical results come from the cited studies, and numerical toy examples are analytical illustrations.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地利用外部工具和可重复使用的技能，这些工具和技能在运行时从包含数千个条目的库中选择。 有关检索器、路由器或技能库“改进”了智能体的报告，可能指的是检索召回率、启用库后成功率的改变、仅限于触发任务的配对对比，或在近似预算约束下的增益。 这篇批判性综述探讨了每种设计具体比较了什么，以及其基于哪些假设。 在基于估计量的智能体评估方法基础上，我们从六个维度描述了工具和技能的设计：处理对比、目标群体、结果、预算约束、摘要指标和识别假设。 十三项核心实证研究构成了证据综合的基础，并辅以相关的方法论工作以及对更广泛文献在设计层面的解读。 我们的贡献在于明确指出了部分原始作者已经承认的区别，这通过分解触发条件下的配对关系、分析反例以及跨研究比较得以实现。 任务上的配对本身并不能确定调用效应；配对的增益和回归次数衡量的是协议特定的不一致性，而非预期结果恶化的任务比例；模块部署的总效应则与预算约束下的效率问题属于不同范畴。 我们将精心挑选的技能提供方案与检索器替换方案进行比较，将触发子集与所有任务的结果进行比较，并将观察到的成本降低与预算约束下的比较进行对照。 一份报告检查清单和实例分析将这些区别与研究中可以报告的信息联系起来。 本综述并未开展任何新的实验；实证结果均引自已有研究，而数值化的简化示例仅为分析性说明。

paragraphs.en: Tool use turned LLMs from text generators into agents that act [ toolformer , react , toolllm , gorilla ] . The number of callable capabilities has since grown faster than any context window can hold. Benchmarks now contain thousands of APIs [ toolllm , toolret ] , Model Context Protocol (MCP) environments expose hundreds to thousands of tools and servers [ scalemcp , dynamicreact ] , and skill libraries, which package procedures, instructions, and scripts that an agent loads on demand, contain tens of thousands of entries [ skillreason , synthforget ] . A recent line of work therefore treats selection as a component in its own right: a retriever or router builds a shortlist, a gate decides whether a candidate is loaded, and the agent decides whether and how to follow it [ toolsurvey , tabagent ] .
paragraphs.zh: 工具使用使大型语言模型从文本生成器转变为能够执行动作的智能体 [ toolformer , react , toolllm , gorilla ] 。 此后，可调用能力的数量增长速度快于任何上下文窗口所能容纳的规模。 基准测试现在包含数千个 API [ toolllm , toolret ] ，模型上下文协议（MCP）环境暴露出数百到数千个工具和服务器 [ scalemcp , dynamicreact ] ，而技能库则包含数万条条目，这些库封装了智能体可按需加载的流程、说明和脚本 [ skillreason , synthforget ] 。 因此，最近的一系列研究将选择过程视为一个独立的组件：检索器或路由器会生成候选列表，门控机制决定是否加载某个候选项，而智能体则决定是否以及如何遵循该候选项 [ toolsurvey , tabagent ] 。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation practice has not kept pace with these designs. A paper on a new skill retriever may report Recall@10 on a retrieval benchmark and then an end-to-end success rate with one agent. A paper on a skill library may report the average success change when the library is enabled. A third paper may compare tasks on which the agent retrieved a skill with tasks on which it did not. Each number is sometimes presented as the benefit of skills, yet they compare different things. Cho and Park showed that models can display a positive retrieved-versus-skipped lift together with a negative paired contrast on the tasks where retrieval occurred [ skillfollowing ] . Hajimiri et al. found that the gains of online skill and memory modules for web agents often vanish against a vanilla actor given more interaction steps within a comparable budget [ worththeirtokens ] . Tank and Nama found that the best skill libraries outperform others mainly through fewer paired regressions rather than more gains [ regressiontax ] . In the other direction, SkillsBench reports that curated, task-specific skills raise pass rates in every one of 18 model–harness configurations [ skillsbench ] . Such results do not contradict one another. They answer different questions, and a reader can compare them only after stating which question each design answers.
paragraphs.zh: 评估实践尚未跟上这些设计的发展步伐。 一篇关于新技能检索器的论文可能会报告在某个检索基准上的 Recall@10，然后报告与单个智能体相关的端到端成功率。 一篇关于技能库的论文可能会报告启用该技能库后成功率的平均变化。 第三篇论文可能会比较智能体检索到技能的任务与未检索到技能的任务。 每个数值有时都被呈现为技能带来的好处，但它们实际上比较的是不同的事物。 Cho 和 Park 指出，在发生检索的任务中，模型可能同时表现出“检索成功 vs. 跳过”的正向提升以及“配对对比”的负向差异 [ skillfollowing ]。 Hajimiri 等人发现，对于网络智能体而言，在线技能和记忆模块带来的增益，在与基础演员模型相比时，若给予更多交互步骤且预算相当，通常会消失 [ worththeirtokens ]。 Tank 和 Nama 发现，最佳技能库之所以优于其他库，主要在于其配对回归更少，而非增益更高 [ regressiontax ]。 另一方面，SkillsBench 报告称，经过精心挑选的特定任务技能能够提升所有 18 种模型–执行器配置中的通过率 [ skillsbench ]。 这些结果彼此并不矛盾。 它们回答了不同的问题，读者只有在明确每个设计所回答的问题后，才能对它们进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Tool learning [ toolsurvey ] , agent evaluation and benchmarking [ yehudai2026 , mohammadi2025 , nageshwaran2026 , kehkashan2026 ] , and trajectory-level failure attribution [ wang2026tse ] have all been surveyed. These surveys organize the literature by capability, benchmark, metric, or failure type. A directly related methodological study by Huang asks what an LLM-agent leaderboard rank compares [ huang2026leaderboard ] . It specifies the target population, measurement source, resource rule, common support, and uncertainty needed to interpret pairwise system comparisons. Estimand-based reasoning is therefore already part of agent evaluation. Our focus is on comparisons that enable, replace, or trigger a tool or skill component within an agent. We examine how conditioning on a within-run trigger interacts with the coupling of stochastic runs, and why paired outcome flips differ from the share of tasks whose expected outcomes worsen. paragraphs.en: This is a critical narrative review, not a systematic review or meta-analysis. We do not pool effect sizes or grade study quality. The aim is to examine the design logic of representative studies. The search closed on 25 September 2026. Sources were arXiv, the ACL Anthology, and conference proceedings, searched with combinations of tool retrieval , tool selection , skill retrieval , skill routing , skill library , MCP , counterfactual , and evaluation . We also tracked citations backward and forward from two seed papers: one on actual skill use [ skillfollowing ] and one on classifier replacement of agent decision components [ tabagent ] . We included studies of LLM agents that retrieve, select, activate, or use tools or skills, provided that the studies reported a component-level metric or a task-level outcome. paragraphs.en: We distinguish five levels at which a tool or skill evaluation can take measurements:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将工具或技能评估的测量层面分为五个等级：

paragraphs.en: Exposure: which candidates the agent can see or call, such as a shortlist, a tool menu, or skill names and descriptions preloaded into the system prompt [ menu , howmanytools ] .
paragraphs.zh: 可见范围：智能体能够看到或调用的候选项，例如候选名单、工具菜单，或已预加载到系统提示中的技能名称和描述 [ menu , howmanytools ]。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval: which candidates a retriever or router ranks highly for the current query or state [ toolret , fieldaware ] .
paragraphs.zh: 检索：检索器或路由器针对当前查询或状态高度排序的候选项 [ toolret , fieldaware ]。

paragraphs.en: Activation: whether a surfaced candidate is loaded into context or executed [ skillapt , radeg ] .
paragraphs.zh: 激活：是否将已呈现的候选项加载到上下文中或执行 [ skillapt , radeg ]。

paragraphs.en: Use: whether the agent follows the loaded procedure or tool output, and how [ skillfollowing , gnndefer ] .
paragraphs.zh: 用途：智能体是否遵循已加载的流程或工具输出，以及以何种方式遵循 [ skillfollowing , gnndefer ]。

paragraphs.en: Outcome: task success, together with cost, latency, and risk.
paragraphs.zh: 结果：任务成功，以及成本、延迟和风险。

paragraphs.en: These levels describe a typical workflow and tell us what an evaluation measures. They are not a complete causal graph. The order can vary: exposure may precede retrieval (preloaded metadata) or follow it (a retrieved shortlist), and in multi-step agents the whole sequence can recur at every step, with each decision changing the state on which later decisions depend. A skill can also affect the outcome without passing through every level. Skill names and descriptions in the system prompt can change behavior when the skill is never invoked [ regressiontax ] , and a larger context can change behavior even when selection is correct [ shadowing ] . Figure 1 shows the typical order together with this direct path and the state feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 这些层级描述了一个典型的工作流程，并告诉我们评估所衡量的内容。 它们并非一个完整的因果图。 顺序可能有所不同：暴露可能先于检索（预加载的元数据），也可能在检索之后（检索出的候选列表）；在多步骤智能体中，整个序列可能在每一步重复出现，且每个决策都会改变后续决策所依赖的状态。 一项技能也可以在未经过所有层级的情况下影响结果。 系统提示中的技能名称和描述可能会在技能从未被调用时改变其行为 [ regressiontax ]，而更长的上下文即使在选择正确时也可能改变其行为 [ shadowing ]。 图1展示了典型的顺序，以及这条直接路径和状态反馈。

paragraphs.en: Precise event definitions matter because several studies condition on them. In this review a candidate is surfaced when it appears in the agent’s visible candidate set; retrieval is called ( R call = 1 R^{\mathrm{call}}=1 ) when the agent or harness issues a retrieval request; retrieval returns ( R ret = 1 R^{\mathrm{ret}}=1 ) when that request yields at least one candidate; a skill is loaded ( R load = 1 R^{\mathrm{load}}=1 ) when its body enters the context; a tool is executed when a call is issued and returns; and content is followed when the agent’s subsequent actions depend on it in the sense a study defines, for example by a behavioral annotation [ skillfollowing ] . Studies differ in these definitions, and we note the definition used whenever a result depends on it. Below, R R denotes whichever of these events a study conditions on.

paragraphs.en: Three choices must be fixed before any comparison is meaningful. The first is the unit : a task, a task paired with a random seed, or a pair of runs. The second is the coupling of arms. Arms can be run independently given the task. They can share a random seed, as in several studies below. Or both arms can branch from one recorded state. A shared seed specifies a joint sampling protocol. The dependence it induces between the arms should be described, including whether environment and serving randomness are also controlled; a coupling does not require the two arms to produce similar trajectories. The third is the number of runs per task and arm. It determines how precisely μ a ​ ( x ) \mu_{a}(x) can be estimated and which inferences are possible. paragraphs.en: Rather than a single list of “effects”, we describe each design along six axes (Table 1 ). The treatment contrast answers what is changed. It can be the availability of a module, a swap of one component for another (a retriever, a shortlist head, a tool menu), an activation policy, or the composition of a library. The target population answers over what the quantity is averaged: all tasks, a subgroup defined before treatment, a subgroup defined by a post-treatment event such as triggering, or a set of states within trajectories. The outcome may be success, cost, or risk exposure. The budget constraint may be absent, an ex-ante cap, or an attempt to match realized spending. The summary measure may be a difference in means, a count of paired discordances, the share of tasks whose expected outcome falls, or a value function. The identification assumptions say what must hold for the summary to be a causal quantity rather than a description of one protocol.

paragraphs.en: With availability as the contrast, τ \tau answers “should this module, as specified, be switched on?”. With a component swap, it answers “should component A A replace component B B ?”. paragraphs.en: A module that consumes tokens changes two things at once: what the agent knows and how much computation it spends. If the treatment is “deploy this module with its overhead”, a well-designed comparison with and without the module identifies the total effect of that package. The extra computation is part of the treatment and one path of its effect, not a confounder. A budget-constrained comparison answers a different question: which configuration to choose when total spending is capped. Defining it requires an ex-ante cap B B and a rule for allocating B B within each arm, because realized spending is itself a post-treatment outcome. The web-agent study of Hajimiri et al. is the clearest example [ worththeirtokens ] . Its control arm extends the vanilla actor’s horizon from 10 to 15 steps and adds accessibility-tree pruning. The authors state that this step cap approximates, and does not exactly match, the token budgets of the augmented methods; in most tasks the control spends fewer tokens, and in a few it spends slightly more. The finding that augmentation gains often vanish therefore concerns this approximate budget constraint. It does not show that comparisons without budget matching are invalid. A complete report gives the total effect, the costs in each arm, and, where resource efficiency is claimed, a budget-constrained comparison or a cost–success frontier [ scoresnotdecisions , costutility ] .
paragraphs.zh: 一个消耗标记的模块会同时改变两件事：智能体所知道的信息以及其消耗的计算量。 如果处理方式是“部署该模块及其带来的额外开销”，那么通过合理设计有模块和无模块的对比，就能确定该模块包的整体影响。 额外的计算量是处理方式的一部分，也是其影响的一条路径，而非混淆因素。 受预算限制的对比则回答另一个问题：在总支出受到限制时，应选择哪种配置。 要定义这种对比，需要事先设定一个上限 B B，并制定在每组中分配 B B 的规则，因为实际支出本身是一个后处理结果。 Hajimiri 等人对网络智能体的研究是最清晰的例子 [ worththeirtokens ]。 其对照组将基础行动者的时间范围从 10 步扩展到 15 步，并增加了可访问性树的剪枝操作。 作者指出，这个步数上限只是近似地反映了增强方法的标记预算，而非完全一致；在大多数任务中，对照组的标记消耗更少，而在少数任务中则略多。 因此，增强带来的增益常常消失这一发现，与这种近似的预算限制有关。 但这并未表明不匹配预算的对比就是无效的。 一份完整的报告应包含整体影响、各组的成本，以及在声称资源效率时，提供受预算限制的对比或成本–成功前沿 [ scoresnotdecisions , costutility ]。

paragraphs.en: A natural remedy for the retrieved-versus-skipped contrast is to pair each task with a run in which the module is unavailable, and then restrict the comparison to tasks where the module arm triggered retrieval. Skill Following formalizes this as the Retrieval-Invoked Actual-Use Effect (RAE), using the returned-skill event R ret R^{\mathrm{ret}} as the trigger [ skillfollowing ] . Pairing removes the between-task difficulty gap that makes the retrieved-versus-skipped contrast misleading. Taken alone, it does not make the restricted contrast a causal effect of invocation.
paragraphs.zh: 一种解决“检索成功”与“跳过检索”对比问题的自然方法，是将每个任务与一个模块不可用的运行过程进行配对，然后将比较限制在那些模块分支触发了检索的任务上。 Skill Following 将这一方法正式化为“检索触发实际使用效应”（RAE），并使用“技能返回”事件 R ret R^{\mathrm{ret}} 作为触发条件 [ skillfollowing ]。 通过配对可以消除任务之间的难度差异，而这种差异会使“检索成功”与“跳过检索”的对比产生误导性。 仅凭这一点，并不能使这种受限的对比成为由触发行为所导致的因果效应。

paragraphs.en: Skill Following runs both arms with the same task prompt, generation seed, and decoding configuration (its Section 4.3). This defines a dependent coupling. What the paper does not state is how the shared seed relates the random events that drive triggering in the skill-enabled run to those that drive success in the skill-disabled run, whose prompt lacks the tool definition. Both selection terms in Equation ( 2 ) are therefore unknown, and so is their difference. The authors themselves describe RAE as “a protocol-conditional paired outcome signal”, state that it is not an unbiased causal effect over a pre-treatment task population, and list the further ablations that a finer causal decomposition would need, including metadata-only retrieval and oracle retrieval (Limitations). We follow that reading. RAE is a useful diagnostic: under a fixed protocol, did the triggered segment of the chain go with better or worse outcomes than the paired control? It is not a model-level measure of how well skills are used.

paragraphs.en: Readers of trigger-conditioned results usually want one of two things, and they require different designs. The first is the availability effect within the triggering stratum : among runs or tasks that would trigger when the module is available, how does having the module change the outcome? Principal stratification defines this target [ frangakis2002 ] , and assumptions such as principal ignorability given observed task features can identify it [ dinglu2017 , lu2026 ] . For runs rather than tasks, a stated coupling between arms is also needed. The analogy with complier effects in instrumental-variable analysis [ angrist1996 ] is instructive but only partial, because the trigger is an event within a stochastic run rather than a stable property of the task. Even when identified, this target remains an availability effect. It still includes every path through which availability acts, such as metadata in the prompt, context occupancy, and behavior before the call. As an analytic example, suppose that listing skill descriptions in the prompt improves every task while the skill bodies themselves are useless. The availability effect among triggering runs is then positive, although loading a body has no effect.
paragraphs.zh: 阅读受触发条件影响的结果的读者通常想要两种结果之一，而这两种结果需要不同的设计。 第一种是触发层中的可用性效应：在模块可用时会被触发的运行或任务中，模块的存在如何改变结果？ 主分层定义了这一目标 [frangakis2002]，并且基于已观察到的任务特征的主可忽略性等假设可以识别出该目标 [dinglu2017, lu2026]。 对于运行而非任务，还需要明确说明各分支之间的耦合关系。 与工具变量分析中的合规者效应 [angrist1996] 的类比具有启发意义，但仅具部分适用性，因为触发是随机运行中的一个事件，而非任务的稳定属性。 即使能够识别出这一目标，它仍然属于可用性效应。 它仍然包含所有可用性产生作用的路径，例如提示中的元数据、上下文占用以及调用前的行为。 作为一个分析示例，假设在提示中列出技能描述能够提升所有任务的效果，而技能本身的内容则毫无用处。 此时，触发运行中的可用性效应为正，尽管加载技能内容本身并未产生任何影响。

paragraphs.en: First, the identity holds for the paired statistics of any protocol and any coupling. It says nothing about the causal interpretation of its components. The decomposition of Equation ( 2 ) applies to D skip D_{\mathrm{skip}} as much as to D pair D_{\mathrm{pair}} , with the event R 1 = 0 R_{1}=0 in place of R 1 = 1 R_{1}=1 . Second, the total and one component do not determine the other unless π \pi is also reported: a complete report gives ( π , D pair , D skip ) (\pi,D_{\mathrm{pair}},D_{\mathrm{skip}}) or, equivalently, ( π , τ pair , D pair ) (\pi,\tau_{\mathrm{pair}},D_{\mathrm{pair}}) . When π = 1 \pi=1 the complement is empty and D skip D_{\mathrm{skip}} is undefined; when π = 0 \pi=0 the same holds for D pair D_{\mathrm{pair}} . Third, a non-zero D skip D_{\mathrm{skip}} is consistent with presence effects of the kind described in Section 3.1 , but it does not demonstrate them, because it also contains selection terms. Attributing it to metadata in context requires an arm in which only the metadata is present, which is the ablation Skill Following names [ skillfollowing ] . paragraphs.en: Among the core studies, SkillApt is the closest approximation of this quantity for skill activation. It defines potential outcomes for an execution state and builds evidence from matched WITH and WITHOUT executions that share task, model, decoding, environment, and evaluator [ skillapt ] . In its frozen confirmatory evaluation, the state is represented by hashed features of the task question, so the learned utility is conditional on the task rather than on a mid-trajectory state. Correctness is primary and costs serve only as tie-breaks. Pairs in which either arm suffers an infrastructure failure are censored, and two persistent no-skill timeouts left 111 of 113 confirmatory states complete, so the confirmatory result is a complete-case analysis. Confidence-gated retrieval with matched trajectory replay illustrates the difference between this quantity and neighboring ones [ confgated ] . It holds candidate answer states, evidence points, budgets, and costs fixed and compares confidence-to-action controllers on these fixed paths, which is a controller swap. Calibrating the probability that the current answer is correct, comparing controllers on fixed paths, and estimating the incremental value of another retrieval are three different targets. The study addresses the first two and concludes that the third requires a separate value-of-information estimate. It therefore shows why calibration cannot substitute for estimating v φ v^{\varphi} .
paragraphs.zh: 在核心研究中，SkillApt 是对技能激活这一量的最接近近似。 它为执行状态定义了潜在结果，并从共享任务、模型、解码、环境和评估器的匹配 WITH 和 WITHOUT 执行中构建证据 [ skillapt ]。 在其冻结确认性评估中，状态由任务问题的哈希特征表示，因此学到的效用取决于任务，而非轨迹中间状态。 正确性是首要的，成本仅用于打破平局。 任一分支发生基础设施故障的配对均被删失，且两个持续无技能的超时导致 113 个确认性状态中仅有 111 个完成，因此确认性结果是基于完整病例的分析。 结合匹配轨迹重放的置信度门控检索，展示了该量与相邻量之间的差异 [ confgated ]。 它保持候选答案状态、证据点、预算和成本固定，并在此类固定路径上比较置信度转行动控制器，这是一种控制器替换。 校准当前答案正确的概率、在固定路径上比较控制器，以及估计另一次检索的增量价值，是三个不同的目标。 该研究解决了前两个问题，并得出结论：第三个目标需要单独的信息价值估计。 因此，它阐明了为何校准不能替代对 v φ v^{\varphi} 的估计。

paragraphs.en: A different decision is execution selection : whether to run the downstream agent at all on a given query and retrieved bundle. RADEG is of this kind [ radeg ] . Its score predicts the probability that executing the agent on the query–bundle pair yields a non-zero verifier reward, and its gate decides whether to launch that execution (its Section 4.1). The gate does not choose between loading and not loading a skill within one run, so it does not estimate v φ ​ ( s , k ) v^{\varphi}(s,k) : there is no baseline in which the same state continues without the skill. If a skipped execution is assigned zero reward, the gate targets a well-defined execution-selection utility, and the probability of non-zero reward, the expected reward, and the cost of execution must then be kept apart. The bundle-perturbation study that motivates RADEG is a separate treatment contrast, a comparison of bundle compositions on the same query, and should not be conflated with the gate’s prediction target. Because the gate does not alter the executed agent’s internal policy, its policy value can be evaluated from logged executions when the logs support both decisions, the execution mechanism is fixed, tasks are independent, and the reward feedback follows the stated protocol. RADEG’s evaluation on logged rollouts with query-level held-out splits is of this type. It differs in kind from replaying trajectories in which an intermediate action has been changed (Section 4.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 另一种决策是执行选择：即是否要在给定的查询和检索到的捆绑包上运行下游智能体。 RADEG 就属于这一类 [radeg]。 其分数预测了在查询-捆绑包对上执行该智能体时获得非零验证器奖励的概率，而门控机制则决定是否启动该执行（见第 4.1 节）。 门控机制不会在一次运行中选择是否加载技能，因此它不估计 v^{\varphi}(s,k)：因为不存在在不使用该技能的情况下状态保持不变的基础线。 如果跳过执行被赋予零奖励，那么门控机制的目标就是一个明确定义的执行选择效用；此时，非零奖励的概率、期望奖励和执行成本必须保持分离。 促使 RADEG 提出的捆绑包扰动研究是一种独立的对比处理，即在同一查询下比较不同的捆绑包组成，不应将其与门控机制的预测目标混为一谈。 由于门控机制不会改变已执行智能体的内部策略，因此当日志同时支持两种决策、执行机制固定、任务相互独立且奖励反馈遵循既定协议时，其策略值可以从记录的执行日志中评估出来。 RADEG 在带有查询级保留分割的记录展开数据上的评估就属于这一类型。 它与重播那些中间动作已被更改的轨迹（第 4.5 节）在性质上有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Relevance to the query may be the wrong unit. Several studies argue that the object to retrieve is an executable set rather than a list of individually relevant items. Tool Graph Retriever adds dependency information so that prerequisite tools are not omitted [ tgr ] . HYSET scores whole tool sets as hyperedges and reports gains in both retrieval and end-to-end success on ToolBench [ hyset ] . Diverse Skill Routing penalizes redundant skills to improve full coverage of multi-skill queries [ dsr ] . R3-Skill retains rejected skill combinations as supervision for set compatibility [ r3skill ] , and CaSKG calibrates directed edges between skills with counterfactual probes before graph expansion [ caskg ] . State-Path Tool Menus treat the menu as an execution prior over routes from the observable state to the goal. On ToolBench, with one executor and deterministic decoding, the authors report online success rising from 0.737 to 0.898, and their 32-tool menu covers more complete chains than the official 128-tool list [ menu ] . For tasks that require complete tool chains, set-level coverage of the required chain is therefore a useful candidate component metric. Whether it predicts outcomes better than single-item relevance across settings has not been tested directly.

paragraphs.en: How many candidates to show is itself a decision. Repantis et al. note that no standard metric evaluates whether a shortlist length suits a query. They propose a chance-corrected measure and report, in a downstream check with one model, that shorter adaptive lists improve correct-tool selection [ howmanytools ] . CAM-DF treats tool acquisition as cost-aware stopping over ranked prefixes and reports exposing the agent to 37% fewer tools than full access with comparable task success in live execution [ scoresnotdecisions ] . SchemaRouter finds that minimizing the number of selected fields reduced answer accuracy, while a recall-preserving projection restored it [ schemarouter ] . All three show that exposure trades recall against context load and cost, and Recall@k alone does not reveal these trade-offs.
paragraphs.zh: 要展示多少候选项本身就是一个决策。 Repantis 等人指出，目前没有任何标准指标能够评估候选列表的长度是否适合某个查询。 他们提出了一种经过概率校正的衡量方法，并在一个使用单一模型的下游验证中报告称，较短的自适应列表能提升工具选择的正确性 [ howmanytools ]。 CAM-DF 将工具获取视为在排序后的前缀上进行的成本感知式停止过程，并报告称，与完全访问相比，该方法使智能体接触到的工具减少了 37%，同时在实际执行中的任务成功率相当 [ scoresnotdecisions ]。 SchemaRouter 发现，最小化所选字段的数量会降低回答准确性，而保留召回率的投影方法则能恢复这种准确性 [ schemarouter ]。 这三种方法都表明，工具暴露程度在召回率、上下文负载和成本之间存在权衡，而仅凭 Recall@k 无法揭示这些权衡关系。

paragraphs.en: Component metrics do not transfer across query sources. On ToolRet, a retriever fine-tuned on one source-specific slice collapses on another slice of the same benchmark [ sourcestyle ] . In a production router over 34,396 skills, fine-tuning on synthetic data improved in-distribution retrieval but caused catastrophic forgetting on real and out-of-distribution queries [ synthforget ] . Retrieval benchmarks built from generated queries [ skill2query , reinvoke ] are especially exposed to this gap between evaluation queries and deployment traffic.

paragraphs.en: Many retrieval papers now add an end-to-end check. Skill2Query reports that improved retrieval translates into higher agent success across several LLM backends [ skill2query ] . Capability Pages improve Recall@10 for all five tested retrievers and add 3.62 points of end-to-end success on average when negative-boundary text is included, with both arms sharing the executor [ capabilitypages ] . SkillDreamer, SkillDAG, and SkillLens report both retrieval and task-level gains [ skilldreamer , skilldag , skilllens ] . These results measure beyond the retrieval level. In the terms of Section 3.4 , each is a component-swap total effect within one agent, one benchmark, and usually one budget. Three limits follow.
paragraphs.zh: 许多检索论文现在都增加了一项端到端的检查。 Skill2Query 报告称，检索能力的提升能转化为多种 LLM 后端中智能体成功率的提高 [ skill2query ] 。 Capability Pages 提升了所有五个受测检索器的 Recall@10 指标，并在包含负边界文本时平均增加了 3.62 分的端到端成功率，且两个分支共享执行器 [ capabilitypages ] 。 SkillDreamer、SkillDAG 和 SkillLens 报告了检索和任务层面的双重提升 [ skilldreamer , skilldag , skilllens ] 。 这些结果衡量的是超越检索层面的表现。 根据第 3.4 节的术语，每一项都是一个智能体、一个基准测试以及通常一个预算内的组件替换总效应。接下来是三个限制条件。

paragraphs.en: A component-swap effect does not show that skills help relative to no skills. A better retriever can raise success over a weaker one while the whole module still lowers success relative to no module. SkillsBench instead compares no skills with curated, task-specific bundles, which raise the macro pass rate from 33.9% to 50.5% across 18 configurations [ skillsbench ] . These bundles are supplied for the evaluated tasks, so the result concerns their availability, not retrieval from a shared library. The same study reports that skills the agent generates for itself fall below the no-skills baseline on the three configurations where this condition was run. Availability effects therefore depend strongly on what the library contains.
paragraphs.zh: 组件替换效应并未表明，与不使用任何技能相比，使用技能会有所帮助。 更优秀的检索器可以比性能较弱的检索器取得更高的成功率，但整个模块与不使用任何模块相比，仍会降低成功率。 SkillsBench 则通过比较“无技能”状态与经过精心挑选、针对特定任务的技能包，发现后者在 18 种配置中将宏观通过率从 33.9% 提升到了 50.5% [ skillsbench ]。 这些技能包是为所评估的任务专门提供的，因此该结果反映的是它们的可用性，而非从共享库中检索的能力。 同一项研究还指出，智能体自行生成的技能在三种运行此条件的配置中，其表现低于“无技能”基准线。 因此，可用性效应强烈依赖于库中所包含的内容。

paragraphs.en: Read together, SkillsBench and the retrieval studies support distinct decisions. Curated provision tests whether a particular bundle helps when supplied; retrieval from a shared library tests the deployed selection package against its stated baseline; replacing a retriever or its representations tests which component performs better within that package. Capability Pages, for example, compares representations with and without negative-boundary text while holding the executor fixed [ capabilitypages ] . Its gain supports that replacement in the evaluated setting. It neither estimates the no-skills contrast in SkillsBench nor transports SkillsBench’s gain to shared-library retrieval. A study addressing both deployment and component choice would need a no-skills arm as well as the alternative retrieval arms on the same task population. The present cross-study evidence motivates those contrasts but cannot supply their missing outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，SkillsBench 和检索研究支持不同的决策。 精选提供测试特定组合在提供时是否有效；从共享库中检索则测试已部署的选择包与其声明的基准表现；替换检索器或其表示形式，则可测试该组合中哪个组件表现更优。 例如，能力页面在保持执行器不变的情况下，比较了包含和不包含负边界文本的表示形式 [ capabilitypages ]。 其增益支持在该评估场景中进行替换。 它既没有估计 SkillsBench 中的无技能对比，也没有将 SkillsBench 的增益迁移到共享库检索中。 一项同时涉及部署和组件选择的研究，需要在同一任务群体中设置一个无技能对照组以及不同的检索方案组。 当前的跨研究证据为这些对比提供了动机，但无法提供其缺失的结果。

paragraphs.en: The path from better recall to better outcomes is assumed rather than tested. An outcome gain that accompanies a recall gain is consistent with better candidates being used, but also with changes in context length, formatting, or the presence of different text [ regressiontax ] . Capability Pages present their product-form success model explicitly as an attribution sketch rather than an identity [ capabilitypages ] . Designs that separate the paths remain rare. The invocation-conditioned decomposition of Song and Wei [ shadowing ] and the trigger-conditioned pairing of Skill Following [ skillfollowing ] are exceptions, subject to the qualifications of Sections 3.5 and 3.6 .

paragraphs.en: Retrieval versus activation. SkillApt treats “which skill is relevant” and “whether loading it is worthwhile” as separate decisions. SkillApt targets a task-conditional value of loading (Section 3.8 ). For confidence-gated retrieval in question answering, matched trajectory replay compares confidence-to-action controllers on fixed paths and shows that calibration changes which questions are answered without estimating the benefit of another retrieval [ confgated ] ; it is a useful counterexample to treating calibrated confidence as a value estimate. RADEG addresses a neighboring decision, whether to run the downstream agent at all on a query and its retrieved bundle; its gate predicts the probability of a non-zero verifier reward, and its motivating study separately shows, with same-query bundle perturbations, that reward is sensitive to bundle composition while relevance scores predict it poorly [ radeg ] . Their shared lesson is that the value of a candidate depends on context and must be estimated from contrasts, not read off relevance scores.

paragraphs.en: Activation as a learning problem. When skill selection is learned inside a policy, credit assignment is itself an attribution problem. paragraphs.en: Use versus obedience. An agent may call a tool and adopt its output without judgment. Wang and Vemuri found that a ReAct agent given a graph neural network as a tool agreed with the tool’s raw predictions 97.6–99.2% of the time, and that deference increased with backbone capability [ gnndefer ] . A selective-invocation gate recovered part of the gap to an oracle but yielded no net global gain. Conversely, silent tool failures, such as a cached error page in the expected format, are consumed as fact. Outcome Monitors that flag contract violations and name recovery tools raised completion in injected-failure settings, and removing the recovery-tool list eliminated the measured gain [ outcomemonitors ] . Both findings show that “the tool was used” is not a success criterion; an evaluation must specify what correct use means.
paragraphs.zh: 使用与服从。 智能体可能调用工具并直接采用其输出，而无需进行判断。 Wang 和 Vemuri 发现，当 ReAct 智能体以图神经网络作为工具时，它在 97.6%–99.2% 的情况下会同意该工具的原始预测，并且这种服从程度会随着基础模型能力的提升而增强 [ gnndefer ]。 选择性调用门控机制部分弥补了与理想结果之间的差距，但并未带来全局净收益。 相反，工具静默失效（例如以预期格式返回的缓存错误页面）会被当作事实直接接受。 能够标记合同违规并调用恢复工具的“结果监控器”，在注入故障的设置中提高了任务完成率；而移除恢复工具列表则消除了所测得的收益 [ outcomemonitors ]。 这两项发现都表明，“工具被使用”本身并非成功标准；评估必须明确界定正确使用的具体含义。

paragraphs.en: Skill Following reports, across 17 LLMs on coding and mathematics tasks, that models can have a positive retrieved-versus-skipped lift and a negative paired contrast on the tasks where retrieval occurred [ skillfollowing ] . The authors already delimit the paired contrast as protocol-conditional. Our decomposition explains why: both which tasks enter the subset and which stochastic outcomes enter within a task matter, with the latter depending on the coupling. The sign of this contrast cannot be substituted for the all-task availability effect or the effect of loading a skill at a fixed state.
paragraphs.zh: 《技能跟随》报告指出，在 17 个大型语言模型（LLM）执行编码和数学任务时，模型在发生检索的任务中可能表现出“检索成功 vs. 跳过”的正向提升效应，以及“配对对比”的负向效应 [skillfollowing]。 作者已将“配对对比”明确限定为协议相关的条件性对比。 我们的分解分析解释了原因：哪些任务被纳入子集，以及同一任务中哪些随机结果被纳入，这两者都至关重要，而后者取决于耦合机制。 这种对比的符号不能替代所有任务中的可用性效应，也不能替代在固定状态下加载某项技能所产生的效应。

paragraphs.en: Regression Tax and Failure prevention retain paired outcome changes as well as aggregate success [ regressiontax , vasudev2026 ] . They show why an average can conceal gains on some observed pairs and losses on others. Their treatments and populations differ: one changes skill libraries in document and spreadsheet tasks, while the other adds critic interventions across question-answering and interactive tasks. Their repetition also differs: Regression Tax runs each condition once per task, whereas Failure prevention uses two or three seeds depending on the configuration. These are complementary demonstrations of paired discordance, not directly comparable estimates of a common harm rate. More seeds can characterize variation in the reported counts, but the counts alone do not estimate the share of tasks with lower expected success. That target requires the per-task uncertainty treatment in Section 3.7 .

paragraphs.en: Effects of individual skills do not add up to the effect of a library. Song and Wei study SkillsBench task–model pairs in which every authored skill raised the pass rate by at least 4 percentage points over no skills (38 pairs from two models). Moving from these helpful skills to a 202-skill library lowers the pooled pass rate by 21 percentage points (26 for one of the two models), and the authors decompose the drop by conditioning on which skills the agent invoked [ shadowing ] . The results therefore concern a population selected for skills that help, and the text we read does not state whether the runs used for this selection were separate from those used for estimation. Their decomposition holds either the invocation probabilities or the conditional pass rates fixed, and their upper bounds rely on an assumption that conditional pass rates under the full library do not exceed those under the helpful set. Self-evolving agents that distill skills from their own trajectories show a phase transition past a critical pool size. New skills degrade performance, defective skills seed later ones, and post-hoc removal recovers only a small fraction of the loss [ contamination ] . paragraphs.en: Hajimiri et al. instead strengthen the vanilla web-agent control by extending its actor horizon from 10 to 15 steps and adding accessibility-tree pruning [ worththeirtokens ] . Under this approximate resource comparison, the control matches or surpasses three online augmentation methods in aggregate success across four WebArena domains and three models, often with fewer total tokens. The authors explicitly note that the step cap does not exactly match token budgets. Because both the horizon and pruning change, this comparison assesses the augmented systems against that specified control package; it does not isolate the effect of extra steps alone. The same study separately ablates horizon extension and pruning under Gemini 3 Flash across the four WebArena domains (its Section 5.3, Table 5), reporting that the longer horizon mainly improves success while pruning mainly reduces token use [ worththeirtokens ] .
paragraphs.zh: Hajimiri 等人则通过将其智能体执行步数从 10 步扩展到 15 步，并加入可访问性树剪枝，从而增强了基础版网页智能体控制方法 [ worththeirtokens ]。 在这种近似资源对比中，该控制方法在四个 WebArena 领域和三种模型上的总体成功率与三种在线增强方法相当甚至更高，且通常所需的总令牌数更少。 作者明确指出，步数上限并不完全对应于令牌预算。 由于执行步数和剪枝策略均发生了变化，此对比将增强系统与上述指定的控制方案进行了评估，而非单独分析增加步数的影响。 同一研究还分别对 Gemini 3 Flash 在四个 WebArena 领域上执行了步数扩展和剪枝的消融实验（见其第 5.3 节、表 5），报告指出更长的执行步数主要提升了成功率，而剪枝则主要减少了令牌使用量 [ worththeirtokens ]。

paragraphs.en: Replay is not intervention. Offline replay evaluates a changed component by substituting its output into logged trajectories while assuming that the rest of the trajectory is unaffected. Gonuguntla tested this assumption for per-step model switching on SWE-bench [ swebench ] with branching rollouts and same-model control forks. Swaps rewrote 61–94% of post-fork actions, only 3% of replayed states remained valid, and replay mispredicted every success-relevant outcome [ replaygap ] . The study concerns model switching, but the same logic applies to any component that changes what the agent does next: its counterfactual outcomes should come from executed continuations unless replay has been validated for that component.
paragraphs.zh: 重播并非干预。 离线重播通过将其输出代入已记录的轨迹中，同时假设轨迹的其他部分不受影响，来评估一个被更改的组件。 Gonuguntla 在 SWE-bench [ swebench ] 上针对每一步模型切换进行了这一假设的测试，测试中使用了分支式展开和同模型控制分支。 替换操作重写了 61%–94% 的分支后动作，仅有 3% 的重播状态保持有效，且重播对每个与成功相关的结果都做出了错误预测 [ replaygap ]。 该研究关注的是模型切换，但同样的逻辑也适用于任何改变智能体下一步行动的组件：除非已针对该组件验证过重播的有效性，否则其反事实结果应来自已执行的后续步骤。

paragraphs.en: Off-policy estimation needs support. Where logged data rather than new runs are used, classical off-policy estimators apply [ li2011 , dudik2011 ] , but only for actions that the logging policy actually took. A working paper on counterfactual tool ranking with exact-propensity logs finds that an initially favorable doubly robust result reversed against full-return direct regression in one setting, and that absolute policy values are not identifiable for unsupported actions [ cftoolrank ] . Personalized skill routing takes a different route: a profile-counterfactual benchmark holds the task fixed and varies only the user profile, so the effect of the profile on which skill is correct is built into the data [ personalized ] .
paragraphs.zh: 离策略估计需要支持。 当使用已记录的数据而非新运行数据时，经典的离策略估计方法适用 [ li2011 , dudik2011 ]，但仅适用于记录策略实际采取的动作。 一份关于反事实工具排名的研究论文（基于精确倾向性日志）发现，在一种设定中，最初有利的双重稳健结果在与完整回报直接回归比较时发生了逆转，并且对于无支持的动作，绝对策略值是不可识别的 [ cftoolrank ]。 个性化技能路由采取了不同的方法：一个配置文件-反事实基准保持任务不变，仅改变用户配置文件，因此配置文件对正确技能的影响已内嵌于数据中 [ personalized ]。

sents.en: Off-policy estimation needs support.
sents.zh: 离策略估计需要支持。

sents.en: Where logged data rather than new runs are used, classical off-policy estimators apply [ li2011 , dudik2011 ] , but only for actions that the logging policy actually took.
sents.zh: 当使用已记录的数据而非新运行数据时，经典的离策略估计方法适用 [ li2011 , dudik2011 ]，但仅适用于记录策略实际采取的动作。

sents.en: A working paper on counterfactual tool ranking with exact-propensity logs finds that an initially favorable doubly robust result reversed against full-return direct regression in one setting, and that absolute policy values are not identifiable for unsupported actions [ cftoolrank ] .
sents.zh: 一份关于反事实工具排名的研究论文（基于精确倾向性日志）发现，在一种设定中，最初有利的双重稳健结果在与完整回报直接回归比较时发生了逆转，并且对于无支持的动作，绝对策略值是不可识别的 [ cftoolrank ]。

sents.en: Personalized skill routing takes a different route: a profile-counterfactual benchmark holds the task fixed and varies only the user profile, so the effect of the profile on which skill is correct is built into the data [ personalized ] .
sents.zh: 个性化技能路由采取了不同的方法：一个配置文件-反事实基准保持任务不变，仅改变用户配置文件，因此配置文件对正确技能的影响已内嵌于数据中 [ personalized ]。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the outcome variable must capture the failures that matter. ToolChain-CRC shows that calibrating on the final answer alone can miss retrieval and tool failures, whereas trajectory-level calibration kept accepted-trajectory risk below its target [ toolchaincrc ] . An outcome that ignores intermediate tool errors can make a harmful component look neutral.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，结果变量必须能够捕捉到那些真正重要的失败。 ToolChain-CRC 表明，仅基于最终答案进行校准可能会忽略检索和工具使用中的失败，而轨迹层面的校准则使“已接受轨迹”的风险保持在目标值以下 [ toolchaincrc ]。 忽视中间工具错误的结果可能会让一个有害的组件看起来是中性的。

paragraphs.en: Name the treatment and the question. “Skills”, in current papers, can mean making metadata visible, retrieving with a particular retriever, loading a skill, or following it, and a comparison can ask whether to deploy a module, which component to prefer, or what to do at a given state. These are different contrasts with different answers. A paper should state which contrast it manipulates and which question it answers before reporting results.
paragraphs.zh: 命名该处理方法和所研究的问题。在当前的论文中，“技能”可能指使元数据可见、使用特定的检索器进行检索、加载某个技能或遵循该技能；而比较问题则可能涉及是否部署某个模块、优先选择哪个组件，或在特定状态下应采取何种行动。 这些是不同的对比，且各自有不同的答案。 在报告结果之前，论文应明确说明其处理的对比方式以及所回答的问题。

paragraphs.en: Treat post-treatment strata with care. Pairing on the task removes between-task selection but not within-task selection (Section 3.5 ). A trigger-conditioned contrast should be reported together with the trigger event, the trigger rate, and the complementary contrast, and it should be interpreted as a protocol-specific diagnostic unless the coupling between arms and the identifying assumptions are stated. Even when identified, an effect within the triggering stratum is an availability effect; a claim about invoking a skill needs a design that intervenes on the load decision.
paragraphs.zh: 谨慎处理治疗后分层。 按任务进行配对会消除任务间的选择，但不会消除任务内的选择（第 3.5 节）。 应将与触发条件相关的对比结果连同触发事件、触发率以及互补对比一并报告；除非明确说明各分支之间的耦合关系和识别假设，否则该对比应被解释为特定于该方案的诊断指标。 即使能够识别出效应，触发分层内的效应也属于可用性效应；若要提出关于技能调用的主张，则需要采用能够干预负荷决策的设计。

paragraphs.en: Report discordance as discordance. Counts of gains and regressions are informative [ regressiontax , vasudev2026 ] , but they describe a protocol, not the share of tasks harmed (Section 3.7 ). Claims about harm to tasks need repeated runs per arm and interval-based summaries, such as the shares of confidently and possibly degraded tasks, or a stated model for task-level effects.
paragraphs.zh: 将不一致性报告为不一致性。 增益和退化的计数具有信息价值 [ regressiontax , vasudev2026 ]，但它们描述的是一个协议，而非受损害任务的比例（第 3.7 节）。 关于任务损害的论断需要针对每个分支进行重复运行，并提供基于时间间隔的摘要，例如可确定已退化或可能已退化的任务比例，或者一个明确说明任务级影响的模型。

paragraphs.en: Distinguish total effects from budget-constrained comparisons. Both are legitimate. A total effect answers whether to deploy a module as specified; a budget-constrained comparison answers which configuration to choose under a cap. Resource-efficiency claims need the latter, or a cost–success frontier [ worththeirtokens , scoresnotdecisions ] .
paragraphs.zh: 区分总体效应与预算受限比较。两者都是合理的。 总体效应回答的是是否应按指定方式部署某个模块；而预算受限比较则是在预算上限下选择哪种配置。 资源效率的主张需要后者，或者一个成本–成功边界 [ worththeirtokens , scoresnotdecisions ] 。

paragraphs.en: Match component metrics to task needs. For tasks that require tool chains, set coverage and prerequisite recall are closer to what the task needs than single-item relevance, and risk exposure needs its own measure [ menu , hyset , samecaprisk ] .

paragraphs.en: Coupling and identification. Skill Following’s Section 4.3 reports shared task prompts, generation seeds, and decoding configurations; its Limitations explicitly delimit RAE as protocol-conditional [ skillfollowing ] . This supports a diagnostic on the triggered subset under that pairing protocol. A local invocation claim would additionally need an intervention on loading at a fixed state, with metadata, remaining budget, and continuation policy specified. The gap is between targets, not an unacknowledged causal claim by the source authors.
paragraphs.zh: 耦合与识别。 《技能跟随》第 4.3 节报告了共享任务提示、生成种子和解码配置；其“局限性”部分明确将 RAE 限定为协议相关的 [skillfollowing]。 这支持针对该配对协议下被触发的子集进行诊断。 一个本地调用声明还需要在固定状态下进行加载干预，并指定元数据、剩余预算和续写策略。 差异存在于目标之间，而非源作者提出的未获承认的因果主张。

paragraphs.en: Discordance and degradation. Regression Tax’s Sections 3.4–3.6 and 6.2 report one run per condition and task and state that run-to-run variance is not estimated [ regressiontax ] . The paired counts support a description of flips in those executions. A claim about the share of tasks whose expected success decreases would require repeated per-task evidence with simultaneous uncertainty bounds or a stated model; repeating the same discordance summary would not by itself supply that claim.

paragraphs.en: Budget. The web-agent budget study’s Sections 3.2–3.3, 5.1, and 5.3 and Appendices B–D specify the longer actor horizon, pruning, repeated runs, and approximate token comparison [ worththeirtokens ] . paragraphs.en: Invocation effects with run-level triggers. The trigger is an event within a stochastic run, not a fixed property of a task. Principal-stratification methods identify availability effects within strata under assumptions such as principal ignorability [ dinglu2017 , lu2026 ] . In the studies reviewed here, we found none that states a potential-outcome model for runs, including how triggering varies across runs of the same task and how the arms are coupled, under which a stratum effect or a local invocation effect is identified. Specifying such models for agents, and designs that intervene on the load decision at scale, remains open.
paragraphs.zh: 具有运行级触发的调用效应。 触发器是随机运行过程中的一个事件，而非任务的固定属性。 主分层方法在主可忽略性等假设下，识别各分层内的可用性效应 [ dinglu2017 , lu2026 ] 。 在我们回顾的这些研究中，没有发现任何一项提出了关于运行的潜在结果模型，包括触发机制在同一任务的不同运行中如何变化、各处理组如何耦合，以及在此条件下如何识别分层效应或局部调用效应。 为智能体构建此类模型，以及设计能够大规模干预负载决策的方案，仍然是尚未解决的问题。

paragraphs.en: This review is narrative and not exhaustive, and work posted after 25 September 2026 is not covered. Selection was purposive, and one author read and characterized all studies, so no inter-rater check was possible. The thirteen component evidence studies in Table 3 and Huang’s related methodological study were read in full; the remaining agent studies are characterized by their stated designs and headline results, and a full reading could qualify some of those characterizations. The targeted related-work addition described in Section 2 does not establish exhaustive coverage. Most sources are preprints whose results have not been independently reproduced. We make no quantitative synthesis, because benchmarks, agents, budgets, and outcome definitions differ too much for pooled numbers to be meaningful. The framework of Section 3 is an analytical tool derived from the literature and from standard causal inference, not a validated instrument; the checklist examples illustrate its use but do not validate it.
paragraphs.zh: 本综述为叙述性综述，而非全面详尽的综述，且2026年9月25日之后发表的研究未被涵盖。 研究选择具有目的性，且仅由一位作者阅读并描述了所有研究，因此无法进行评分者间一致性检验。 表3中列出的十三项证据研究的组成部分以及Huang的相关方法论研究均被完整阅读；其余智能体研究则根据其明确说明的研究设计和主要结果进行了描述，而完整阅读可能会修正其中某些描述。 第2节所述的目标相关研究补充并未构成全面覆盖。 大多数文献均为预印本，其研究结果尚未经过独立验证与复现。 我们未进行定量综合分析，因为基准、智能体、预算和结果定义存在显著差异，导致合并后的数据缺乏实际意义。 第3节的框架是一种基于文献和标准因果推断方法推导出的分析工具，而非经过验证的测量工具；检查表示例仅用于说明其使用方法，而非对其有效性进行验证。

paragraphs.en: Tool and skill components are currently evaluated with a mix of retrieval metrics, component-swap comparisons, retrieved-versus-skipped contrasts, trigger-conditioned paired contrasts, gain and regression counts, and budget-constrained comparisons, often under the same word. We have argued that these designs compare different things. Some are descriptive, some estimate total effects of deploying or swapping a component, and some describe one protocol without identifying a mechanism. Three interpretations in particular need care. Pairing on the task does not turn a trigger-conditioned contrast into an invocation effect. Regression counts from independent runs measure discordance rather than harm. A comparison without budget matching estimates a total effect rather than an invalid one. Stating the contrast, population, unit and coupling, budget, summary, and identification assumptions of each design costs little, and it lets readers compare results that currently appear to conflict. Agents now draw much of their capability from what they retrieve. Evaluating that retrieval therefore requires stating precisely what each design shows.
paragraphs.zh: 工具和技能组件目前通过多种评估方式加以检验，包括检索指标、组件替换对比、已检索与未检索项的对照、触发条件下的成对对比、增益与回归计数，以及预算受限对比，这些评估通常针对同一词语进行。 我们曾指出，这些设计实际上比较的是不同的事物。 其中一些是描述性的，有些用于估算部署或替换某个组件的总体影响，还有一些则仅描述了某种协议而未明确其机制。 尤其有三种解释需要谨慎对待。 在任务中进行配对并不会将触发条件下的对比转化为调用效应。 来自独立运行的回归计数衡量的是不一致性，而非危害。 缺乏预算匹配的对比所估算的是一种总体影响，而非无效影响。 明确说明每种设计的对比方式、群体、单元与耦合假设、预算、总结及识别假设并不会耗费太多成本，同时也能帮助读者比较那些目前看似相互冲突的结果。 如今，智能体的许多能力都源于其检索到的信息。 因此，要评估这种检索能力，就必须精确说明每种设计具体揭示了什么内容。
